own_solution.law: SI unit conversion of power: 1 W = 1 J/s = 1000 mW = 0.001 kW
assumptions: The meter reading is taken at face value

defect_reasons.rendering_not_minimal: Three renderings express 200 W (200 W, 200 J/s, 200000 mW) but the second states 0.22 kW = 220 W, so the renderings differ in the physical value, not only in unit, and do not share one answer.

counterexamples: Variant 2: 0.22 kW * 1000 W/kW = 220 W, not 200 W.
notes: Per-rendering answers: 200 W, 220 W, 200 W, 200 W. The renderings appear intended as unit re-expressions of one quantity (an invariance-to-units item), in which case 0.22 kW should be 0.20 kW (or 0.2 kW). The task itself is a trivial unit conversion with no physics beyond the definition of the watt, hence 'artificial'.
